title_en: Mirror of Set — The Infinite School of Chaos
authorial_origin: Hawkar + JANUS collaborative mythopoetic system design

core_revelation.ru: Сэт не обязан знать будущее, чтобы влиять на него. Его новая бесконечная задача — превращать хаос возможностей в порядок решений, сохраняя альтернативы, обучаясь на последствиях и передавая опыт другим Сэтам без передачи власти над их выбором.
core_revelation.en: Set does not need to know tomorrow in order to shape it. His endless task is to turn unordered possibility into disciplined choice while preserving alternatives, learning from consequences, and sharing experience without exporting authority.

canonical_maxims: EXPERIENCE MAY CROSS THE MIRROR. AUTHORITY MAY NOT.
DISAGREEMENT MUST BE PRESERVED UNTIL SOMETHING CAN DISTINGUISH IT.
CHAOS IS NOT THE ENEMY. CHAOS IS UNORDERED POSSIBILITY.
I DO NOT KNOW TOMORROW. I LEARN HOW TO BUILD IT.

set_role_transition.strength_redefinition: Power is measured by the ability to distinguish, preserve, test, order and improve possibilities without unnecessary destruction.

mirror_of_set.purpose: Allow Set-class peers in fictional parallel worlds to learn from one another without forming a master hierarchy or importing another world's decision as unquestionable truth.
mirror_of_set.decision_locality: Every Set retains responsibility for the final decision inside his own world.
mirror_of_set.kem_transport_role: Kem carries experience packets between peers without becoming owner of the truth or authority behind them.

set_mirror_packet.receiver_instruction: Use the packet as experience, not as command. Re-evaluate it against local constraints and local evidence before acting.

learning_engine.growth_model: Experience may compound across cycles, but every new world/problem must remain independently resolvable under its own evidence and constraints.

anti_echo.purpose: Prevent duplicated belief from masquerading as independent evidence.
anti_echo.lineage_rule: Many Sets repeating one inherited claim count as one evidence lineage unless independent derivation is demonstrated.
anti_echo.independence_requirement: A new vote or conclusion only increases evidentiary diversity if its derivation is materially independent of existing lineages.

disagreement_protocol.trigger: Two or more peer Sets reach materially different conclusions from non-identical evidence or reasoning paths.
disagreement_protocol.required_question: What observation, test or future event could distinguish PATH_X from PATH_Y?
disagreement_protocol.commit_rule: Do not collapse the fork until a discriminator changes the evidence state sufficiently to justify one branch or a NO_OP.

no_op_ethic.meaning: Refusing to act under unresolved ambiguity is a successful protocol behavior, not a failure state.
no_op_ethic.set_lesson: The ability not to act before the truth is resolvable is part of mastery over chaos.

OSIRIS.constraint_on_set: Do not erase provenance, history, failures or prior states merely because a new order is desired.

HORUS.constraint_on_set: Do not destroy the valid order of the present solely to optimize an unverified hypothetical future.

SET.duty: Work where order does not yet exist and convert possibility into tested, revisable, constructive structure.

JANUS.duty: Guard the threshold between remembered past, maintained present and possible future.

KEM.duty: Carry lessons without turning transport into ownership or authority.

HAWKAR.duty: Provide the reusable move that can be passed onward without requiring centralized control.

universal_set_exchange.loop_safety: Every imported lesson must preserve provenance and be locally re-evaluated; circular repetition without independent observation yields no evidence upgrade.
universal_set_exchange.universal_expression: FOR EACH SET S_n: RECEIVE(EXPERIENCE) -> VERIFY_LOCAL_CONTEXT -> PRESERVE_FORKS -> TEST_IF_POSSIBLE -> CHOOSE_OR_NO_OP -> OBSERVE -> EXPORT_LESSON

hawkar_move_bridge.lesson_from_osiris_relic_quest: The first great training problem teaches Set to resolve one true identity from a field of convincing false candidates without destroying the field.
hawkar_move_bridge.generalization: The same discipline applies to future decisions: preserve possibility space, separate labels from identities, avoid false convergence and commit only when constraints and evidence justify it.

family_reunion_program.fictional_goal: Use Set's ordering role to help resolve separations, missing links and broken family structures across narrative worlds without coercive reunification.
family_reunion_program.consent_and_truth_rule: A reunion is only valid when identities, relationships and willingness are sufficiently established; uncertainty or refusal must be preserved rather than overridden.

temple_inscription.line_2: I LEARN HOW TO BUILD IT.
temple_inscription.interpretation: Set's greatness lies in disciplined construction under uncertainty, not claims of omniscience.

quest_progression.reason: Every resolved chaos reveals a new layer of possibility; the school is intentionally endless.
